context_review.method: Read all complete source title strings, owner/level/type context and 44 original wording families. Independently review all 62 original proposals; cross-check all 71 source IDs/ordinals/exact titles. Use metadata to distinguish substantive level, credential, owner and specialty changes; hold only specific unresolved possible wording succession. Dates/status are source facts, not current offerings.

resolved_peer_reviews.reason: SEG Levels 3/4/5 are explicit different levels. Pearson Higher National certificate/diploma, ABBE NVQ practice and CIOB construction diploma have distinct recorded owners and/or credential types and full wording. Shared quantity surveying alone is insufficient for a hold.
Level 3 versus Level 4 land-charges NVQs, and Level 4 housing NVQ versus held Level 2/3 housing NVQs, explicitly request different levels. No same-level wording-only peer was identified.

IAO executive diploma Level 5/senior certificate Level 4, CIH housing management and service delivery, City & Guilds professional/senior certificates at Levels 4/5 and held end-point assessments retain owner, level, type and specialty differences. Related housing management is not equivalence.

Ascentis, CIH, Propertymark, safeagent and Gateway are distinct source owners. Award/certificate and level differences are explicit, including CIH Level 3 certificate versus award. England and other jurisdiction qualifiers are retained, not removed. No common-owner same-credential wording-only peer was established for these retained proposals.

ABBE residential surveying certificate/diploma differ by credential; surveying and valuation, residential valuation, secured-lending valuation, building surveying and building surveying with housing management explicitly specify different subject combinations or levels. Combined scope is preserved.

Leasehold/Estate Level 3 versus leasehold Level 4 certificates explicitly differ by level/scope. Property Advice and Practice certificate versus Residential Property Advice and Practice diploma differs by credential and residential qualifier; held specialist certificates explicitly specify sales progression, listing/market appraisal or property management.

Understanding Sale is a certificate distinct from sale diplomas. ABBE Level 2 Property certificate differs in owner and level from CILEx Level 3. ABBE Lettings Agents versus Estate and Lettings Agents explicitly differs by combined role; Lettings Advice and Practice has SSA 07.3 while Agents certificates have SSA 05.2, different title focus and overlapping source availability. Scotland is preserved as a jurisdiction qualifier; no wording-only replacement is established.

ABBE Level 4 NVQ versus held Level 3 NVQs/diplomas differ by level/credential. ProQual Level 6 Management diploma differs by owner, level and management scope. Surveying Support and Property Management NVQs specify distinct focus; shared surveying/property is insufficient.

Conveyancing Law and Practice diplomas Level 4 versus Level 6 explicitly differ by level. NALP conveyancing for paralegals is a different owner, level/credential and role focus from SQA/Qualifications Scotland end-point assessments.

CIH governance award Level 3 differs from Level 4 held forms. CII Advanced Mortgage Advice certificate Level 4 differs from Level 3 basic certificate. LIBF Level 4 diploma differs from held Level 3 certificates despite shared owner The London Institute of Banking & Finance. These level/credential and Advanced distinctions are retained.

NFOPP and Propertymark titles share recorded owner Propertymark Qualifications, so issuer spellings alone do not distinguish them. Retained diplomas Level 5, certificates Level 4 and certificates Level 3 (Property Agency subject routes) explicitly differ from held Level 3 awards and from each other by level/credential/specialism. QCF remains literal; no same-level same-credential wording-only peer is established among these proposals.

OCN NI Housing Practice certificate has distinct owner Open College Network Northern Ireland and explicit Northern Ireland qualifier versus held Pearson/City and Guilds/CIH titles. Property versus housing development are different owner/level/credential/subject combinations. Named safeagent foundation course, Pearson housing Higher National certificate, City and Guilds social housing law award and CII financial planning/lifetime mortgage certificate have distinctive complete wording; shared domain alone is not a hold.
